notes:
Quick notes from eval track. Mid-market B2B SaaS building an in-product AI agent for task automation and support. Primary interest is Hosted API for fast ramp, evaluate Dedicated after POC for predictable latency and data isolation. Key ask: stable streaming with tool-calling (external HTTP/webhook actions) and SDK support for streaming-first UI.

Quoted from CTO: "We need p95 conversation latency under 250ms for small messages and first-token streaming to feel instantaneous - anything >400ms degrades UX." Also: "Must be able to redact PII from request logs before retention; SOC2 + SSO mandatory."

AE notes: strong product-led adoption inside their customer base; 2 pilot customers require EU residency. Product team wants a hybrid plan: hosted for general users, Dedicated for high-value enterprise tenants. Concern about hidden per-token costs and burst pricing.
